subject: Learning Methods
title: Synaptic Strengthening
description: A short lesson to help you apply Synaptic Strengthening.

hook.text: Donald Hebb said: neurons that fire together wire together. That phrase captures memory at the cellular level.

buildup.text: When two neurons activate at the same time repeatedly, the synapse between them gets physically stronger.

discovery.text: Long-term potentiation is the name for this strengthening. It is the biological basis of learning.

twist.text: Synapses that are not used weaken over time. Use it or lose it applies at the cellular level.

climax.text: Every time you review material, you fire those synapses again and make the connection more permanent.

punchline.text: Fire together, wire together. Review keeps the wires strong.

quiz.question: What is long-term potentiation?
options: The strengthening of synapses through repeated activation
A type of cramming that works long-term
